automatic_goal_augmentation_analysis.summary: The goal-strategy service automatically transforms user goals into SMART goals without requiring user interaction during the transformation process.

smart_goal_processor.purpose: Core service that handles automatic goal transformation

translateGoal.description: Main method that takes raw goal input and automatically converts it to SMART format using OpenAI
process: Builds detailed prompt for AI transformation (buildTranslationPrompt)
Calls OpenAI API with the prompt
Parses AI response to extract SMART criteria
Returns complete GoalTranslationResult with transformed goal

buildTranslationPrompt.description: Creates detailed prompt instructing AI to analyze goal against SMART criteria
buildTranslationPrompt.output_format: Structured JSON with all SMART components analyzed

callOpenAI.description: Makes API call to OpenAI for automatic transformation

translate_endpoint.description: Main endpoint for automatic goal transformation
automatic_behavior: Receives raw goal string from user
Saves transformed SMART goal to database
Returns complete SMART analysis without user interaction

output.smartCriteria: Detailed analysis of each SMART component
output.confidence: AI's confidence score in the transformation

step1.action: User submits raw goal via /translate endpoint

step2.action: System automatically builds AI prompt with SMART analysis instructions

step3.action: OpenAI automatically analyzes and transforms goal to SMART format

step4.action: System automatically parses AI response and structures SMART criteria

step5.action: Transformed goal automatically saved to database

step6.action: Complete SMART goal returned to user without any interaction

prompt_structure.system_role: Expert goal-setting coach specializing in SMART methodology
analysis_requirements: Convert raw goal to refined SMART goal statement
Analyze each SMART criterion (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound)
Provide confidence scores for each criterion
prompt_structure.response_format: Structured JSON with complete SMART analysis

clarification_processing.purpose: Process user answers to improve SMART goal
clarification_processing.automatic: Partially - requires user input but processing is automatic

chat_endpoints.automatic: Generates responses automatically based on context

configuration.cors_support: Allows X-OpenAI-API-Key header for user API keys

key_insights.fully_automatic: The core goal transformation happens completely automatically without user interaction
key_insights.ai_powered: Uses OpenAI GPT-4 to perform intelligent goal analysis and transformation
key_insights.structured_output: Automatically generates structured SMART criteria with confidence scores
key_insights.proactive_analysis: Automatically identifies missing criteria and generates clarification questions
key_insights.database_persistence: Automatically saves transformed goals for future reference
key_insights.no_user_interaction_required: From raw goal input to complete SMART goal happens in a single API call
